summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, announcing an engagement with Tetra Tech Canada Inc. to conduct a technical review and compile historical data for the wholly owned Morrison Project in British Columbia. The work, expected to take four weeks, involves a conceptual-level economic assessment to support an ongoing strategic review process intended to facilitate evaluation by potential strategic parties. The filing states it will not include a Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA) yet, with that possible in a separate engagement. No deal terms are disclosed. Watch for any subsequent PEA or strategic transaction announcement.
